# db-test-kit-js

> A runnable reference for fast database-backed tests in TypeScript. Copy the patterns into your repository; do not install it as a dependency.

Canonical operational instructions:
- https://github.com/danielrose7/db-test-kit-js/blob/main/RECREATE.md

Documentation:
- /db-test-kit-js/guide/quick-start: run the reference projects
- /db-test-kit-js/guide/how-it-works: rollback, fixtures, factories and the application seam
- /db-test-kit-js/guide/choose-a-path: select Drizzle or Prisma and singleton or dependency injection
- /db-test-kit-js/guide/drizzle: adopt the Drizzle implementation
- /db-test-kit-js/guide/prisma: adopt the Prisma implementation
- /db-test-kit-js/guide/updating: update an existing copied implementation
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/fixtures: design, declare, load and safely use shared fixture data
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/factories: create test-owned variation with pure builds and persisted creates
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/caveats: transaction semantics and escape hatches
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/safety: database isolation and destructive-operation safeguards
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/compatibility: tested versions and support boundaries
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/sources: official documentation, prior art and evidence boundaries
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/lineage/: map each idea to its source and local adaptation
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/lineage/rails: transactional tests, fixtures, identify and factory_bot
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/lineage/frameworks: Django and Laravel parallel precedents
- /db-test-kit-js/reference/lineage/typescript: Vitest, Fishery and transaction-focused prior art
- /db-test-kit-js/agents/: concise instructions for coding agents
- /db-test-kit-js/llms-full.txt: complete documentation in one text file

Source code:
- https://github.com/danielrose7/db-test-kit-js
